story.title: Story 5: Detach Sources and Preserve Prior Provenance

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 5 soft-detach end to end: added the DELETE detach route and store/service flow, preserved detached rows durably for provenance, filtered detached attachments from project and process active views, wired project-shell detach UI, and added the story-mapped detach/provenance tests plus the chunk non-TC durable detach check.

changedFiles.reason: Added `detachSource` orchestration with active-row lookup and 404 mapping.
Registered the DELETE source-attachment route and response handling.
Extended the store contract and implementations with soft-detach persistence plus active-count recalculation.
Filtered detached attachments out of the project source section.
Excluded detached rows from process current sources and applied process-scope shadowing for active resolution.
Added the Convex soft-detach mutation and durable detach marker writes.
Added the client DELETE API helper for source detach.
Added detach controls to source rows.
Passed detach actions into the project source section.
Extended shell wiring with a project-source detach callback.
Handled detach requests and removed only the detached row from shell state.
Updated the source-management store cast to include detach support.
Added the soft-detach durable-vs-active lookup regression test.
Added API coverage for detaching project-scoped and process-scoped sources.
Added coverage that detach does not rewrite an already-hydrated working copy plan mid-run.
Added UI coverage that detaching one source leaves unrelated attachments visible.
Updated the typed capped-store shim to satisfy the expanded detach-capable store contract.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm vitest run tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts tests/service/client/source-management-ui.test.ts tests/service/server/process-execution-orchestrator.test.ts convex/sourceAttachments.test.ts convex/sourceProvenance.test.ts

findingsFixed: Wired the missing detach route/service/store path so DELETE now soft-detaches instead of leaving Story 5 unimplemented.
Filtered detached attachments out of both project and process active-source reads while preserving durable rows for provenance lookups.
Addressed formatter/type-contract issues surfaced during verification by extending the source-management store casts and fixing formatting nits.

openQuestions: `docs/onboarding/current-state-index.md` and the related onboarding docs referenced in `AGENTS.md` are not present in this checkout, so implementation was grounded in the story, tech design, test plan, and current code instead.
result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to verification, with manual project-shell and process-surface detach smoke checks if you want an extra UX pass.
